questions.topic: Inclusion probabilities assigned by a probability sample
questions.stem: A unit has inclusion probability 0.25; what weight corrects it?

questions.subject: RESEARCH_METHODS
questions.topic: Share of pattern responses meeting a cut-point
questions.stem: An architect's brief finds a low share meeting a cut-point; explain what it indicates.

answer.exemplar: A low share meeting the cut-point indicates the pattern is rare or the threshold is strict, which may require revisiting the cut-point or the definition of the pattern.

questions.explanation: The rule that settles this share of pattern responses meeting a cut-point item is: Rarity or strictness. That is why "A low share meeting the cut-point indicates the pattern is rare or the threshold is strict, which may require revisiting the cut-point or the definition of the pattern" is the answer.
